verdict.rationale: Veo is driven by natural-language text prompts. Its docs describe refining results over multiple turns and multi-turn conversational editing, such as element replacement or perspective changes, so the core of the story is directly supported. However, the documented control centers on generation and editing prompts, and fine control relies on structured parameter notation and tokens rather than plain-language commands. Hands-on users also report outputs that miss prompt specifics. Missing for 10: evidence that natural language operates the product beyond generation/editing (settings, parameters, workflow), reliable adherence to natural-language instructions, and independent hands-on corroboration of the conversational editing flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: It excels at quickly turning text prompts and images into short videos, and lets you refine results across multiple turns using the Interactions API.
